facts.label: Note
facts.value: the blue grid symbol of irrigated rice fields fills the plain from 玉泉山 to Haidian and 六郎庄, east and south of 昆明湖 (polygon approximate) Also: AMS 1944 sheet (S20) read by eye, not georeferenced: paddy hatching west and south-west of 海淀 round 六郎庄 and 西苑; point C (Rice paddies of 海淀 and 六郎庄), 467 m from the point used. Also: Tour du monde 1864 sketch read at px 830,635, fit rms 427 m (schematic) (Rizieres (paddy)), 400 m from the point used.
